name: Word Solver
author: byo-pop
description: HINT (beside SUBMIT) or Tab selects a word the board spells: first one that puts out the lowest fire tile, then the bonus word, the best-scoring words and the longest. Press again for the next, or press 1 to 9 and 0 to play one of the first ten at once. Settings save the bonus tiles for one big word, or keep new fire tiles away. Games with it keep their own high scores.

settings.label: Fire tiles first
settings.help: While fire tiles are on the board, the first hint is the word that takes the lowest one.

settings.label: Best words in the cycle
settings.help: How many of the best-scoring words HINT goes through before the longest word and the start again.

settings.label: Show what a hint is
settings.help: A tag above the hint's first tile: best, fire, bonus or longest, its place in the cycle, and a warning for an unsafe word.

settings.label: Save bonus tiles
settings.help: Hints avoid the green, gold, sapphire and diamond tiles where they can, so they stack up for one long word that uses several. After the best words, a CASH IN hint is the best word that uses them.

settings.label: Fewer new fire tiles
settings.help: Classic: hints bring as few new fire tiles as they can. Long words hold fire back, and a new fire tile lands only in a column the word took exactly one tile from. The tag shows the new fire to expect.

settings.label: Number keys play words
settings.help: The keys 1 to 9 and 0 play the solver's first ten words at once, in the order of its list (the widescreen side panel numbers them).
